column1: Dice: "Sin embargo, Miguel el arcángel, cuando contendía con el diablo disputando con él sobre el cuerpo de Moisés."
column2: It says, "Yet Michael the Archangel in contending with the devil when he disputed about the body of Moses."

column1: La Biblia no nos dice sobre qué estaba discutiendo el diablo con respecto al cuerpo.
column2: The Bible doesn't tell us what the devil was arguing about regarding the body.

column1: Estaba discutiendo sobre el cuerpo porque no podía discutir sobre su espíritu, su personalidad, su alma.
column2: He was arguing over the body because he couldn't argue over his spirit, his personality, his soul.

column1: Dado que sabía que Moisés era firme y seguro en Dios, Moisés había creído en Dios y ya le pertenecía.
column2: Since he knew that Moses was steadfast and secure in God, Moses had believed in God and already belonged to him.

column1: Así que el diablo dijo: "Al menos déjame tener su cuerpo."
column2: So the devil said, "At least let me have his body."

column1: Como mínimo, el diablo habría pensado: "Quiero la satisfacción de quitarle la vida a Moisés, de tenderle una trampa y dejarlo morir."
column2: At the very least, the devil would have thought, "I want the satisfaction of taking Moses's life, of setting a trap for him and letting him die."

column1: Pero Dios no lo permitió.
column2: But God did not allow it.

column1: El ángel dice que Dios envió a este ángel para advertir al diablo.
column2: The angel says that God sent this angel to warn the devil.

column1: Ten cuidado con el cuerpo de Moisés. No lo vas a enfermar. No le vas a causar ningún accidente.
column2: Be careful with Moses's body. You are not going to make him sick. You are not going to cause him any accidents.

column1: No lo vas a matar de hambre y no lo vas a matar de sed.
column2: You are not going to starve him to death, and you are not going to kill him from thirst.

column1: Porque yo soy quien tomará la vida de Moisés, no tú.
column2: Because I am the one who will take Moses's life, not you.

column1: Eso podría haber sucedido y podría haber sido lo que el arcángel Miguel estaba disputando con el diablo.
column2: That could have happened and it could have been what the Archangel Michael was disputing with the devil about.

column1: Le prohibió tocar a Moisés antes de su muerte porque el diablo ya sabía que Moisés le pertenecía a Dios.
column2: He forbade him from touching Moses before his death because the devil already knew that Moses belonged to God.

column1: Pero como mínimo, el diablo habría querido atormentar su cuerpo y su vida, hacerlo sufrir, herirlo.
column2: But at the very least, the devil would have wanted to torment his body and his life, to make him suffer, to hurt him.

column1: Dejarle caer una piedra encima y dejarlo en agonía. Todas esas cosas podrían haber sucedido.
column2: To drop a stone on him and leave him in agony. All of those things could have happened.

column1: Pero Dios no permitió que el diablo las hiciera.
column2: But God did not allow the devil to do them.

column1: Así que dice que el arcángel Miguel, que era superior, superior al diablo y un ángel muy superior a los demás, contendía con el diablo.
column2: So it says that the archangel Michael who was superior, superior to the devil and a very superior angel to the others was contending with the devil.

column1: Y así dice que no se atrevió a maldecir al diablo ni a juzgarlo ni a condenarlo, el ángel, sino que lo dejó a Dios.
column2: And so it says that he didn't dare to curse the devil or to judge him or to condemn him, the angel, but left it to God.

column1: Él era el único que podía juzgar y condenar. Por lo tanto, por eso se destaca.
column2: He was the only one who could judge and condemn. Therefore, that's why it stands out.

column1: Dice: "Cuando el arcángel Miguel contendía con el diablo, disputando con él sobre el cuerpo de Moisés."
column2: It says, "When the Archangel Michael was contending with the devil, disputing with him over the body of Moses."

column1: No se atrevió a traer contra él una acusación de blasfemia, sino que dijo: 'El Señor te reprenda por ser necio, por entrometerte, por ser un fraude.
column2: Dared not bring against him a reviling accusation, but said, 'The Lord rebuke you for being foolish, for meddling, for being a fraud.

column1: El Señor te reprenda, Satanás.' Eso es lo que hizo.
column2: The Lord rebuke you, Satan.' That's what he did.
